status: Dense-fuel stutter corrected; powered native cycle outcomes and limitations recorded explicitly.
defects: The root bounds was a trigger with no solid bumper rails. Added four measured perimeter contacts without filling the interior.
With the same bumper, ContinuousDynamic held the chassis despite velocity in dense fuel. Discrete at 4.5 ms removed the reproduced pose/velocity mismatch.
Native nested managed roller array loaded empty. Unity-owned serialized arrays load all nine definitions and restore both powered floors.
measurement_notes: Clear lane: abs(world X)<3, abs(world Z)>3.15, abs(world Y)<0.025, stored load>=20.
Held: horizontal speed>1 m/s and displacement below 35% of velocity-integrated displacement. Samples approximately 22.5 ms apart.
Bumper overlap audits measure the hollow bounds trigger, not penetration through solid rails.
Pre-powered cases had zero live indexer definitions; their results do not establish powered-floor operation.
Stored observation-box counts can vary as balls shift. Transit escapes follow the observed pre-return cohort.
Muzzle observations can miss a fast crossing between samples. Scoring uses the native per-body timestamp.

The real robot stows 50-60 balls, usually returns over the bump, and only retracts the intake/kicker. Earlier aborting stow cases incorrectly moved the main hopper. Fixed-hopper cases keep the main walls, floor and net anchors on the chassis.
The 700 N / 6000 N s/m slide comparison is diagnostic only. The candidate retains 350 N / 1800 N s/m.
